svg.title: Mouse · White
svg.desc: Compact white laboratory mouse in a grounded side view with a low horizontal body, proportionally large pinnae and eye, pointed muzzle, delicate paws, and a thin smooth tail. Biological basis: Mus musculus is distinguished from the laboratory rat by its smaller compact body, relatively prominent ears and eyes, finer feet, sharper muzzle, and thinner tail; coat color is strain-dependent.
